reviewScope: Complete lexical candidate review of the buyer configurator runtime. User-visible controls, messages, accessible labels and price-summary copy are interface-localizable; DOM/CSS/runtime identifiers and internal layout diagnostics are excluded; catalog labels, dimensions and evidence-qualified technical-view descriptions remain domain-owned.
limitations: Inventory only; no localization resources or product runtime were changed.
Product catalog names, dimensions and evidence-qualified drawing descriptions need explicit domain ownership and locale formatting rules.
Flow-layout error strings are internal diagnostics reported through debug state or console and are not buyer-facing copy.
Lexical inventory does not capture all one-word labels or strings authored in HTML and inline scripts.
